name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.database.ui.table.TableInspectorActivity
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. After a table is selected in BigBrother's database browser, this screen shows its columns and rows and lets users inspect expanded values.
disableEffect: BigBrother's table-inspection screen will be unavailable; the app's databases remain unchanged and usable.
